name: Toshima (Tokyo, Japan, ward)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Toshima ward emblem in white: a stylised chrysanthemum enclosing the character 豊.
history: Municipal flag of Toshima, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1982.

features.role: Toshima ward emblem — a stylised chrysanthemum enclosing the character 豊
